periods.sentence: Pre-monsoon burning in the Malwa belt ran well above the 2001–2020 median for six weeks.
Post-monsoon peak coincided with stubble-burning pressure; tile-days reached the top decile of the record.
Spring fire season slightly below normal; cloud gaps in late April are flagged as data gaps, not zeros.
Tentative: an intense late-April spell, still under review against VIIRS confidence filtering.
Autumn burning near the long-term median; percentile rank hovers around p60.
Relay-satellite era begins; early months are Provisional pending cross-calibration.
